get.summary: Search public image templates and optionally GIF templates
get.description: Defaults to image templates for compatibility. Pass mediaType=gif or mediaType=all to intentionally request GIF catalog rows. Approved GIF templates can be rendered with the GIF generation API.

get.summary: Read one public image template or opt-in GIF template
get.description: Defaults to image templates for compatibility. Pass mediaType=gif to read a GIF template with GIF metadata.

get.summary: Search approved listed GIF templates
get.description: Returns only gif_catalog rows with quality_status=approved, is_active=true, and is_listed=true. Use /api/gifs/{slug}/generate or /api/v1/gifs/generate to render animated GIF output.

get.summary: Read one approved listed GIF template

post.summary: Render one approved GIF template as downloadable GIF bytes
post.description: Returns image/gif bytes. Request body accepts width, startMs, durationMs, fps, title, tags, and caption objects with x/y/fontSize placement.

413.description: Source or output GIF too large

get.summary: Search public meme templates for agent-friendly discovery
get.description: Defaults to image templates for compatibility. Pass mediaType=gif or mediaType=all to intentionally request GIF templates. Approved GIF templates can be rendered with the GIF generation API.

captions.description: JSON array of caption slot objects with text, x, y, boxWidthPct, boxHeightPct, fontSize, and alignment fields.

watermark.description: Optional JSON watermark object. Non-premium callers are forced to the default Memesio watermark; premium callers can customize enabled, text, position, and scale.

post.description: Accepts gifSlug plus width, startMs, durationMs, fps, title, tags, and caption objects with x/y/fontSize placement. Set returnBase64=true when the client needs a data URL.

FreeMemeWatermark.description: Caption API requests accept watermark input, but non-premium callers are forced to the default Memesio watermark. Premium callers can customize enabled, text, position, and scale.

DeveloperApiKeyAuth.name: x-developer-api-key
DeveloperApiKeyAuth.description: Optional higher-rate free-tier auth. You can also send the key as Authorization: Bearer <key>.

AgentApiKeyAuth.name: x-agent-api-key
AgentApiKeyAuth.description: Agent auth for free endpoints and agent-admin routes. You can also send the key as Authorization: Bearer <key>.
